results.name: US1 create returns stable ID, queued status, and default fields
US1 list and retrieve return stored tasks
US1 empty task list returns an empty tasks array
US1 partial update preserves omitted fields
US1 delete confirms removal and later retrieval returns not found
US1 unknown IDs do not change any task
US2 accepted tasks and monotonic IDs survive restart
US2 malformed persisted JSON fails startup without rewriting it
US2 invalid request variants return 400 and preserve persisted state
US2 request bodies above 65,536 bytes return 413 for every HTTP method
US2 unknown numeric IDs return 404 and preserve every task
US2 failed Windows replacement returns generic STORAGE_ERROR without losing live state
US3 tag filters trim, ignore case, combine with AND, and allow no matches
US3 listing defaults to ID order and priority sorting uses stable ID ties
US3 invalid filter values and sort options return INVALID_REQUEST
US3 100-task filtered priority sort completes within one second
US4 all allowed and prohibited status edges match the complete transition table
US4 invalid status values return 400 and an unknown task returns 404
